name: Title Screen
note: Baseline of the stock title screen. Bind it in System 1 to replace the title.

name: Main Menu
note: Baseline of the stock main menu. Bind it in System 2 to replace the main / pause menu; the stock menu stays in use until this one is called or bound.

name: Game End
note: Baseline of the stock game end prompt.

name: Status
note: Read-only baseline of the stock status screen. Bind it in System 2 to replace Status; it follows the current menu actor.

name: Options
note: Baseline of the stock options screen. Left/right and confirmation use MZ option wrapping and volume steps.

name: Save
note: Baseline of the stock save screen. Autosave is excluded and the selected manual slot is saved asynchronously.

name: Load
note: Baseline of the stock load screen. Only existing slots are enabled and successful loads continue to the map.
